absences: No dated political or regulatory event after 2026-10-30 found in any angle. Searches for NDAA, NRC commission votes, DOE/DoD policy and CNSC decisions returned only items dated before 2026-10-30, so no Type N items were written.

Part 57 final rule: not found finalized or scheduled. The NRC March 2026 public meeting said it was on target for the November 23 2026 EO 14300 deadline (ANS, 2026-03-13, fetched). Power Magazine (fetched, undated) reports NRC Chairman Ho Nieh conceded some final rules will land beyond the 18-month EO target. No Type G check written: the shipped text ('proposed rule') is consistent with every page found, but none is dated within ~60 days and no NRC primary page was fetched.

Part 57 Federal Register primary text not verified. federalregister.gov and public-inspection PDFs returned redirects or binary content. The June 15 2026 comment deadline rests on a fetched Orrick alert quoting the May 1 Federal Register notice.

ADVANCE Act FY2026 reduced hourly rate ($154): supported only by a search summary of the 2026-06-16 Federal Register final rule (2026-12067). The primary PDF returned binary content and could not be quoted. No FY2027 fee rule found. No Type G check written.

FY2027 NDAA INDOPACOM transportable microreactor provision (Harrigan amendment, House passed 2026-07-22): the House text and a fetched Star-Advertiser column confirm the Jan 1 2030 deadline. Senate version (S. 9022 or S. 4784, bill number conflicting) has no microreactor language found. Final enactment unconfirmed. Not written as a Type F or N record because it is a June-July event already before the window.

FY2027 Energy and Water appropriations: House committee bill (H.R. 9022, $1.8B for Office of Nuclear Energy, committee vote 34-25 on 2026-05-20) found, but no later House floor, Senate or enacted status found. Predates the window.
Maine LD 343 (annual SMR informational-bid solicitation, first solicitation proposed for 2026-10-01): enactment not confirmed, no PUC docket found.
Colorado PUC: Xcel 2027-2028 resource filing (2026-06-15) found, but no SMR or nuclear content confirmed. No SMR ratepayer-funding docket found in the window.

Virginia SCC: Dominion SMR rider filing (announced 2024 as planned for fall) not found as filed. Only a 2026 transmission filing (North Anna to Thornburg, planned fall 2026) found, which is not a microreactor filing.

Louisiana PSC R-37871: already shipped (lpsc-lane-microreactor-vendor-directive-2026). Aug 12 2026 supplemental agenda lists a possible vote on a Final Rule in the same docket; the outcome was not found, so no new record was written.

New Jersey S4849 and A5726 (Micro-Reactor Incentive Act, introduced Oct 2026): S4849 is already shipped (nj-s4849-micro-reactor-incentive-act-2026). A5726 introduced 2026-10-29 was seen only in a search summary; its subject was not confirmed.
Texas Backup Power Package, DOE Launch Pad, Janus awards, and Radiant/Oklo DSA approvals appear in shipped news and deal pathways; not re-checked here.
CNSC: Chalk River USNC MMR site licence application (March 2026) and OPG Darlington SMR operating licence application (2026) found under review; no decision found.
